fixes.explanation: Yes, baker! "Let everything that has breath praise the LORD!" (Psalm 150:6) The psalm doesn't pick a job title or a section of the choir. If you've got breath in you, you're on the list. And that includes you, friend.

I can see the thought, but the psalm doesn't say anything about keeping this praise private. It says, "Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals." (Psalm 150:5) Clashing and resounding are loud words, and I don't think a closet is big enough for them. The verse just calls for cymbals, so loud is the word that fits.
